listing.product_title: Vitamin D3 5000 IU with K2 MK-7 100mcg - 120 Softgels with Organic Olive Oil for Absorption
listing.product_description: Vitamin D3 and K2 work as a pair: D3 raises calcium absorption, and K2 as MK-7 directs that calcium into bone rather than soft tissue. Taking D3 without K2 is why many people supplementing at higher doses see limited benefit. Each softgel delivers 5000 IU of cholecalciferol D3 alongside 100mcg of MK-7 sourced from natural fermentation, suspended in organic olive oil because both vitamins are fat soluble and absorb substantially better with a lipid carrier than in dry tablet form. Third-party tested by an ISO 17025 accredited lab, with a certificate of analysis available for every batch.
bullet_points: SYNERGISTIC PAIR - 5000 IU D3 with 100mcg K2 MK-7. D3 absorbs calcium, K2 directs it to bone instead of arteries. The two are far more effective together than either alone.
MK-7 FORM, NOT MK-4 - MK-7 has a 72-hour half-life versus roughly 8 hours for MK-4, so one daily softgel maintains steady blood levels. Sourced from natural fermentation.
SUSPENDED IN ORGANIC OLIVE OIL - Both vitamins are fat soluble. Dry tablets absorb poorly on an empty stomach; the olive oil carrier solves this.
THIRD-PARTY TESTED - Every batch verified by an ISO 17025 accredited lab for potency, heavy metals and microbials. Certificate of analysis available by batch number.
120 SOFTGELS, 4 MONTH SUPPLY - Non-GMO, soy free, gluten free. Made in a cGMP certified facility in the USA.
listing.target_audience: adults 30+ supporting bone density and cardiovascular health

listing.product_title: Magnesium Glycinate 400mg Elemental - 180 Capsules, Chelated for Absorption, Third-Party Tested
listing.product_description: Magnesium glycinate is magnesium bound to the amino acid glycine. That chelated form is absorbed roughly twice as efficiently as magnesium oxide and does not draw water into the bowel, which is why oxide causes the digestive upset that stops most people from continuing. Each serving provides 400mg of elemental magnesium, not 400mg of the compound, a distinction many labels blur. Glycine itself is mildly calming, which is why this form is the one typically studied for sleep quality and stress. Third-party tested for heavy metals and potency with a certificate of analysis published for each batch.
bullet_points: 400MG ELEMENTAL MAGNESIUM - Not 400mg of compound. Many brands list total compound weight, which can mean under 100mg of usable magnesium per serving. Read the label carefully.
CHELATED GLYCINATE FORM - Bound to glycine for roughly 2x the absorption of magnesium oxide, with none of the laxative effect that makes oxide hard to tolerate at therapeutic doses.
FORMULATED FOR SLEEP AND STRESS - Glycine is mildly calming on its own. This is the form used in most sleep quality research, not citrate or oxide.
THIRD-PARTY TESTED - Heavy metals, potency and microbial testing on every batch by an independent ISO 17025 lab. Certificate of analysis available on request.
180 CAPSULES, 3 MONTH SUPPLY - Vegan, non-GMO, no magnesium stearate or artificial fillers. Made in a cGMP certified US facility.
listing.target_audience: adults supporting sleep quality, muscle recovery and stress

listing.product_title: Vitamin C Serum 15% L-Ascorbic Acid with Vitamin E and Ferulic Acid - 30ml Amber Glass, pH 3.2
listing.product_description: This serum uses 15% L-ascorbic acid, the only form of vitamin C with substantial clinical evidence behind it, at pH 3.2 where it stays stable and penetrates. It is paired with 1% vitamin E and 0.5% ferulic acid in the ratio shown in dermatology research to roughly double photoprotection and extend the antioxidant's stability. L-ascorbic acid oxidises on exposure to light and air, so it ships in amber glass with an airless pump rather than a clear dropper bottle. A faint yellow tint is normal; discard if it turns deep orange.
bullet_points: 15% L-ASCORBIC ACID AT pH 3.2 - The pure form used in clinical studies, not a gentler derivative like sodium ascorbyl phosphate. pH below 3.5 is required for it to penetrate.
THE FERULIC ACID TRIO - 15% L-ascorbic acid with 1% vitamin E and 0.5% ferulic acid, the combination shown in dermatology research to approximately double photoprotection and slow oxidation.
AMBER GLASS, AIRLESS PUMP - Vitamin C degrades in light and air. Clear dropper bottles let it oxidise within weeks. This packaging is a formulation decision, not a cosmetic one.
TARGETS DARK SPOTS AND DULLNESS - Supports a brighter, more even tone over 8 to 12 weeks of daily morning use under sunscreen.
30ML, FRAGRANCE FREE - No added fragrance or essential oils. Vegan, cruelty free, and patch testing is recommended for sensitive skin.
listing.target_audience: adults targeting dark spots, dullness and early signs of ageing

listing.product_title: Hyaluronic Acid Serum - 5 Molecular Weights with B5 - 30ml for Multi-Depth Hydration
listing.product_description: Most hyaluronic acid serums use a single high molecular weight that sits on the surface and can feel tight as it dries. This uses five weights from 2,000 to 1,500,000 daltons so hydration is delivered at several depths rather than only the top layer. Vitamin B5 is included to help hold that water in place. Apply to damp skin and seal with a moisturiser; in a dry climate, hyaluronic acid applied to dry skin can draw moisture outward rather than in, which is the most common reason people find it does not work for them.
bullet_points: FIVE MOLECULAR WEIGHTS - From 2,000 to 1,500,000 daltons. Low weights reach deeper layers, high weights hold surface moisture. Single-weight serums only do one of those.
VITAMIN B5 INCLUDED - Panthenol supports the skin barrier and helps retain the water the hyaluronic acid attracts.
APPLY TO DAMP SKIN - Then seal with moisturiser. On dry skin in low humidity it can pull moisture from the skin rather than into it. This instruction matters more than the formula.
LAYERS WITH ANYTHING - No acids, fragrance or actives that conflict. Safe alongside retinol, vitamin C and niacinamide, and suitable during pregnancy.
30ML, FRAGRANCE FREE - Non-comedogenic, vegan, cruelty free, suitable for all skin types including sensitive.
listing.target_audience: all skin types, including dehydrated and sensitive skin
